v.subject: Reunion roster - headcount needed by Friday
v.body:
Hi —

Final call on the Harbor reunion roster. I need a definite headcount
by Friday or the hall goes to the wedding party. So far I have 14
confirmed, 6 maybe. Which are you?

Also: someone still has the lighthouse slides from '98. If it's you,
bring them.

— Marta

v.name: 003-devon.eml
v.subject: Field notes: the Otter Creek survey
v.body:
Attached the raw transect counts from Tuesday. Two anomalies worth
a second look:

 1. Station 4 — heron count tripled vs last year (9 vs 3). Either a
    new rookery upstream or a double-count. I'd bet on the rookery.
 2. Station 7 — turbidity reading looks instrument-flawed; the probe
    was fouled with duckweed.

Weather held. Boots did not.

— D
